text: <speak>I'm Bell's virtual assistant, I use artificial intelligence to learn. <break time="1s"/></speak>

text.text: I'm wondering if you have received my return yet

text:
Please note it can take 7-10 days from the time you sent your package for items to arrive at our warehouse and to be processed. If you were billed equipment non-return fees, it can take 1-2 bill cycles for the return to be credited and to appear on your bill.

Do you have your tracking number?
Equipment returns can be tracked on either the Canada Post or Purolator website. I'll send a text to the device you're calling from, so that you can track your returns. Is that alright?
Sorry, I can't send you a text at the moment, due to an unexpected system issue.
<speak>You can check out our frequently asked questions at <say-as interpret-as="url">support.bell.ca/mobility/prepaid</say-as></speak>
What else can I help you with today?
